name: LK Technology
tagline: Software, bots and AI, under a flock of ASCII pigeons.
what: The landing page of LK Technology, a small software, bots and AI studio. The whole page is one night scene that visitors can poke at.
points: The only copy is the name, the line "Software, bots and AI." and a "Click to scatter seed" prompt, so the interaction is the pitch.
Every pigeon, power line, moon and skyline is drawn from text characters, which ties the illustration to the code-first brand.
Set in IBM Plex Mono throughout, with light grey text (#CDD8DB) on a deep navy ground (#151F29).
Clicking scatters seed and the pigeons flock down and take off, so the page reads as a small toy before it reads as a company site.

flow.caption: Scene at rest, pigeons on the wire and ground
Second click, the flock takes off and lands
